event.elara_heart2.1.text: That's a farm blister. Bandage on. ...Your hand is shaking. Sit a minute. I'll do the talking, you do the sitting.
event.elara_heart2.1.why: Frightened: the joke gives way to plain care; she treats it like anyone who looks unwell.

event.elara_heart2.1.text: That's a farm blister. I see ten a week. Bandage on. Your hands are cold, though. Are you sleeping?
event.elara_heart2.1.why: Uneasy: she notices the tiredness, asks, keeps it light.

event.elara_heart2.3.text: Oh! That paper behind the kettle? A map. Of places I haven't been. Yet! The woods aren't on it. Nobody goes there.
event.elara_heart2.3.why: Hint: the woods as an ordinary village blank spot she has never questioned.

event.elara_heart5.1.text: It's a mitten with two thumbs, so it fits either hand. You've looked cold lately. Wear it anyway. Wear it twice.
event.elara_heart5.1.why: Uneasy: the gift becomes quiet care for a player who seems off.

event.elara_heart5.3.text: Someday I'll show you my list. When you're feeling better. It'll keep. So will I.
event.elara_heart5.3.why: Frightened: the doodle joke would land wrong; she trades it for a promise.

event.elara_heart5.3.text: Someday I'll show you my list. Dr. Penn crossed one place off it once. Harrow Wood. She said, 'Not that one.'
event.elara_heart5.3.why: Clue: a Keeper's too-exact care, seen from outside. Elara thinks it was a joke; the player may not.

event.past_the_point.2.text: The boat leaks, politely. Felix pulls the oars. Behind them the wood sits closer to the shore than it should. Elara does not look back.
event.past_the_point.2.why: Uneasy, full: the woods seem closer, seen only from the water.

event.past_the_point.2.text: The boat leaks, politely. Felix pulls the oars. Elara holds her hat down. On shore, the fog sits on the treeline and does not lift.
event.past_the_point.2.why: Uneasy, mild: fog that will not lift, nothing named.

event.past_the_point.horizon.text: The shore's just a line now. The wood's a darker line behind it. I feel small and glad. Mostly glad.
event.past_the_point.horizon.why: Her best moment, with one honest shadow in it.

dlg.past_point.talk.r2.text: Straight out! Where the shore can't follow. ...I'll hold the sandwich tin. It's very steadying. Medically.
dlg.past_point.talk.r2.why: Frightened: she reads the player's choice as wanting to get away, and goes along gently.

dlg.elara.garden.visit.1.text: Edmund brought me comfrey every spring, tied with twine. Last fall he came by just to sit a while. I've missed him. Oh, rambling on your step.
dlg.elara.garden.visit.1.why: Day two, before any lore: Edmund's last fall in one human detail. A question, no answer.

dlg.elara.garden.visit.2.text: Could I ask a favor? The clinic garden is bare. Three dandelions and three wild garlic, please. Field ones, not by the forest gate. Dr. Penn is fussy!
dlg.elara.garden.visit.2.why: Hint: Penn's rule about the gate, relayed as fussiness. A place to go and look.

dlg.elara.list.1.text: Places I've never been. Forty-one of them. Dr. Penn counted them once, very slowly. Then she went quiet. ...Well? Say something!
dlg.elara.list.1.why: Clue: the number lands on Penn, not on Elara. Echoes Dorian's count without stating it.

dlg.elara.list.r0.text: Together! The sea, from a boat. Far from the trees, for a whole day. I'm circling it. I'm already packing!
dlg.elara.list.r0.why: Uneasy: she offers the player somewhere else to be, without saying why.

event.elara_heart8.intro.text: Come see! It lives behind the kettle. You look like you need somewhere else to think about. Don't laugh. Or do. Please do.
event.elara_heart8.intro.why: Frightened: the reveal becomes her remedy for the player.

event.elara_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday! ...You look worn through. Sit. Cake first, questions never. The hat has its own hat, look!
event.elara_birthday.intro.why: Frightened: she leads with care, then pulls the player back toward the silly hat.

event.elara_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday! I knitted myself a hat, and the hat has its own hat! You look tired. Come in, sit down!
event.elara_birthday.intro.why: Uneasy: one small noticing inside the party.

event.elara_courtship.intro.text: Here's a scarf. It's warm, and you've looked cold lately. The last row is a question: would you court me? It's in red. Very serious!
event.elara_courtship.intro.why: Uneasy: the scarf as comfort as well as question; the question itself is unchanged.

dlg.elara.courtship.r2.text: Think! Take all the time you need! Just come by in daylight. Everyone says so. I'll add a row a day.
dlg.elara.courtship.r2.why: Hint: she has absorbed the village custom without asking why.

event.elara_courtship2.intro.text: The scarf grew. A row a day. Some nights two, when I couldn't sleep. The last row still asks. Would you court me?
event.elara_courtship2.intro.why: Frightened: the village's sleeplessness reaches her too, told plainly.

dlg.elara.partners.0.text: Dr. Penn gave me the afternoon off! She said 'go' twice and 'home by dark' once. How shall we spend it?
dlg.elara.partners.0.why: Hint: Penn's exactness, passed on without comment.

dlg.elara.partners.r2.text: The beach at sunset! A blanket and three snacks. We'll walk home by Tilda's lamp. The blanket is ours.
dlg.elara.partners.r2.why: Uneasy: the evening walk gets a safe light to come home by.

event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l3.text: You like it! It has a spare, for laundry day. And you closed early on the fourth again!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l3.why: Hint: the clinic shut on the fourth; Penn's 'No' now reads as a dodge.

event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l1.text: Soup for everyone! Seven vegetables, one a surprise! I used rainwater. The well tastes like a key.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l1.why: Uneasy, full: wells tasting of iron, put in her own homely terms.

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l1.text: Dr. Penn, you were out till all hours on the fourth. I counted. So I knitted you a sleeping mask!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l1.why: Hint: a Keeper abroad on the ritual night, noticed as overwork.

event.overheard_felix_elara_1.l4.text: I knew you'd love it! Next one's bigger. Felix, where did the gulls go? It's so quiet.
event.overheard_felix_elara_1.l4.why: Uneasy: birds quieter, asked of the one person who would know.

event.overheard_felix_elara_2.l4.text: Too late! I told the whole waiting room! It's full lately. Nobody's sleeping through the night.
event.overheard_felix_elara_2.l4.why: Uneasy, full: the sleepless village, as a nurse sees it.

event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l4.text: I won't! Nineteen. Twenty. ...The fish are all facing the shore. Toward the trees. Do fish do that?
event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l4.why: Frightened, full: animals facing the wood; the count falters.

event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l4.text: I won't! Nineteen! Twenty! The fish are all facing one way today. Listening, I bet.
event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l4.why: Uneasy, mild: same image, no direction named.

event.elara_heart8.after.text: {if choice:list.pick}We picked one. The sea, from a boat. Circled twice. Felix has a boat, you know. Far out is good for thinking.{else}{if choice:list.add}You added a place. It's in the margin: 'Somewhere [player] suggests.' Somewhere quiet, I hope. You need quiet.{else}You promised. I'm holding you to it. Gently. You look like you could use gentle.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_heart8.after.why: Uneasy: each branch keeps its meaning and adds one small, practical noticing.

event.elara_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.elara.yes}Courting! The scarf's long enough for two. Wear it home. Wear it to sleep, if you're sleeping.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.elara.friends}Friends, then. I'll knit it in blue, so it's calm. You look like you need calm.{else}Still thinking? That's all right. The scarf will keep. So will I. Come by in daylight.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_courtship2.after.why: Frightened: warmth turns toward rest and safety; every answer keeps its meaning.

event.elara_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.elara.hat}The hat lives on my shelf now, with its smaller hats. You wore it all evening. You looked warmer.{else}{if choice:courtship.elara.knit}Our row is the middle of the scarf. Your hands were cold, so it's crooked. It's my favorite part.{else}The sunset was pink. We counted boats. The gulls never came. Someday one of the boats is ours.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_partners.after.why: Uneasy: one shadow per branch (cold hands, absent gulls) inside the happiest scene.

adds.text: And sleep tonight. Curtains shut, lamp on, tea in reach. Nurse's orders, the nice kind.
adds.why: Practical, ordinary comfort for a player who looks unwell.

adds.text: ...Oh. You're pale. Sit first. The present can wait thirty seconds.
adds.why: Frightened: she stops her own surprise to look after the player.

adds.text: Felix, the birds stopped when we passed the point. Do birds take breaks?
adds.why: The unaware villager's puzzled aside; Felix's next line still closes the scene.

threads.elara_heart2: Why is the one place nobody goes the one place missing from a map of everywhere?
threads.elara_heart5: Why did Dr. Penn cross Harrow Wood off a list of places Elara only dreams of visiting?
threads.past_the_point: What does the wood look like from the water, and why did the birds go quiet at the point?
threads.elara_garden_visit: What made Edmund stop bringing comfrey and start coming by just to sit, the fall he died?
threads.elara_heart8: Why did forty-one make Dr. Penn go quiet?
threads.elara_birthday: If even Elara can see how worn the player is, what is keeping them up?
threads.elara_courtship: Why does everyone, even Elara, say to come by in daylight?
threads.elara_courtship2: What is keeping the whole village, Elara included, awake at night?
threads.elara_partners: Why does a doctor giving an afternoon off add 'home by dark'?
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_1: Why does the clinic close early on the fourth?
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_2: Why does the well water taste of iron?
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_3: Where was Dr. Penn until all hours on the fourth?
threads.overheard_felix_elara_2: Why is no one in Wetherell sleeping through the night?
threads.overheard_felix_elara_3: What are the fish facing, and why the trees?

notes: The cozy list has forty-one places, the same number as Dorian's forty-one trees. I used it at clue tier (Penn counts them and goes quiet); Elara never links the two. If the match was an accident, cut dlg.elara.list.1's variant.
New canon-adjacent detail: Penn once crossed Harrow Wood off Elara's list ('Not that one'). Penn's persona should agree, or the Director should cut it.
Garden visit variant n1 is gated only on horror:1 because the scene plays on spring 2 of year 1, before any lore or dread can build.
Planned cut of event.elara_heart5.3 at dread>=60 was illegal (last line), so it became a frightened variant instead.
Round 3b: branched variants added for heart8.after, courtship2.after and partners.after. birthday.after and courtship.after stay plain on purpose, for contrast.
